programmes.d: Danny Pruitt travels around the country fishing in some of the nation's best kept secrets all while discovering the communities, culture, food, and the people that make each episode unique and entertaining.
Capt. Justin has a blank check to build the best fishing boat possible; but it doesn't come quickly.
Hosts Justin Leake and Travis Holeman highlight the coastal lifestyle and diverse fishing opportunities in Panama City Beach, Fla.
From its inception, the F E Hill Ranch creates opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories, including a tradition of fathers and sons hunting together.
In 2010, Amberly Snyder's life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist down. Amberly's harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch.
Practical information for serious whitetail deer hunters.
Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting.

The introduction of non-native species into Australia has had a large impact on native species. Ongoing management throughout the country is a daily task. Dan Cabela meets some of the people taking on this challenge.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor launch out of Key Largo and fish their way up a creek filled with monsters.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Captain Tony Young for a day of offshore fishing and free diving out of Islamorada, Fla.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head deep into the Everglades to target snook in the murky waters of Lake Ingraham.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor use Lowrance Active Target all day to locate fish, first targeting bridge tarpon, followed by unearthing a variety of species in Florida Bay's mullet muds.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor chase tarpon of all sizes around Florida Bay and throughout the Everglades.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor catch spotted sea trout and jacks on the grass flats and potholes of Florida Bay.
Tournament angler Blair Wiggins of "Addictive Fishing" continues his fishing adventures but also shares his love of everything outdoors, including hunting, cooking, beekeeping and more.

Capt. Jason Dozier is a full-time fishing and hunting guide passionate about putting friends and clients on anything that can be caught or harvested from or near the water; it's time to showcase these adventures.

When the yellowtail at the islands refuse to play, it's time to switch up the game plan. Ali and Rush pivot north of San Diego in search of hard-charging bluefin tuna during a multi-day mission aboard the 43' custom ACI Catamaran Killer Bee.

Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River.
We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass through PCB's beautiful beach waters each summer. It's a lesson in humility, respect and yes, luck.
Capt Justin says you can catch a redfish 365 days in Panama City Beach. We put those words to the test!
A look at why minerals are so important for the herd; Randy goes through the details of why he uses Big Tine mineral.
The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

Randy is at the Raven spraying some clover plots, trimming limbs, checking tree stand straps, and just doing some overall summertime maintenance. Fast-forward to fall and Randy is able to catch up with one of his top hit list bucks on the Raven.
The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.
Capt. Blair fishes solo near Cape Canaveral; on his return trip, he experiences an unexpected encounter at the buoys; the surprise adds excitement to his solitary fishing day.
Learning the fundamentals of flats fishing and the advanced tactics used by proven tournament anglers.
Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we're experiencing it with one of the area's most respected captains.

Rush welcomes Cullen Lundholm from Cape Cod to experience Key West at its finest; over several action-packed days, they target a variety of species in the incredible waters surrounding the Florida Keys.
Captain Jared Raskob and guest Captain Jimmy Hendricks face challenges from sharks during a fishing trip; the pair adapts their techniques to successfully catch their target species.
Capt. Jonathan Moss is heading deep into the Everglades backcountry taking the Cayo 173 through the winding mangrove tunnels to the home of countless snook and tarpon!
Adam and Logan Hays chase big bucks in the Buckeye State!
Tarif Alkhatib hunts a couple giant whitetails in his home state of Texas!
Focusing on the culture of fishing, as seen through the viewpoints of two drastically different fishermen.

Trenton makes a trip to Louisiana to fish with Theophile Bourgeois at the Cajun Vista Lodge. With an early rain delay, they took a tour of the lodge and learned about its long-standing family history before hitting the water for some redfish.
A peaceful day of reef fishing in Islamorada turns into a kingfish and yellowtail frenzy for Captains Scott and Steve.
It only takes three fish to fill the Yeti cooler when Capt. Scott kite fishes the top for wahoo and Steve pulls a big mutton snapper off the bottom.
Captains Scott and Steve take a long run into the Gulf from Stock Island to load their coolers with cobia and huge yellowtail snapper.
Captains Scott and Steve sail west of Key West to battle with big kingfish and end up with plenty of meat for the smoker.

Captains Steve Rodger and Scott Walker prove themselves to be among the top charter boat and tournament captains in offshore fishing; follow their journey to fishing destinations as they share the techniques that have driven their success.
Highlighting the stories and people who have made the shooting sports and hunting lifestyle a part of their lives.
The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they'll put Winchester's new Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test.
Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting.
Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi-day deer camp; along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau.
Captain Jared Raskob travels to Bolivar, Texas, to fish with Clay Guest and Ryan Pyburn; the group navigates the coastal waters of the Bolivar Peninsula to target local saltwater game fish.

Capt. Jared travels to Venice, Louisiana, where the Mississippi River meets the Gulf, joining Capt. Garrett George and Capt. Jesse LeBoeuf for an action-packed offshore adventure in pursuit of Redfish and Tuna.
